admission.justification: Realized across src/rh_pipeline/graph/stage_map.py, dag/stage-map.json and dag/dag.json with unit tests proving 21-stage validation, strict import-only edges and committed Stage 00 round-trip parity, preventing false dependency edges or stage renumbering.

applicability: Versioned stage-map validation and import-only proof dependency DAG construction across src/rh_pipeline/graph/stage_map.py, dag/stage-map.json and dag/dag.json.
conditions: load_stage_map enforces non-empty stages, consecutive 0..N-1 orders and global uniqueness of stage IDs, upstream paths, skeleton files and derived Lean module names, raising StageMapError on violation.

build_dag derives sorted deduplicated depends_on edges strictly from resolved Lean import statements among mapped nodes, excludes self-edges, ignores unmapped external imports and rejects duplicate declaration names within one skeleton file.
exclusions: Duplicate declaration names across separate files never create dependency edges; Stages 01-20 remain empty files arrays until later masters map them.
statement: load_stage_map validates the 21-stage versioned dag/stage-map.json (mapping all 5 conforming Stage 00 files with empty Stage 01-20 lists) and build_dag constructs dag/dag.json with depends_on edges derived strictly from resolved Lean import statements among mapped nodes without cross-matching duplicate symbol names.
title: Versioned 21-stage map and import-only Stage 00 DAG
